## Open

### T-067 — blong-commander no longer wires a pod log viewer for k8s items

> _2026-09-07 · realm/blong-commander · open_

In blong-commander the pod log viewer is no longer wired for k8s items — they use the generic
`document` viewer after the categories restructure. Re-wiring per-resource-type viewers (pods to
`podLog`) would be a follow-up.

### T-146 — Two explore shots list shared backend data none of their neighbours list

> _2026-09-24 · realm/blong-commander · open_

The redis-keys shot was made deterministic by collapsing the drilled node, but two others still
capture an unfiltered list from a backend shared with every other suite, and both drifted while the
baselines were swept: explore-access-db-tables (0.46% of the shot, the table rows differ because
other suites create access tables) and explore-vault-mounts (0.75%, the mount rows). Every sibling
source filters to a seeded subset first - vault secrets filter to commander-demo, mongo to admin,
kafka to the seeded message - so the fix is the same shape: filter the access table list to a seeded
subset, and either filter or mask the vault mount list. Until then those two baselines bake whatever
the environment held on the day they were written.
